latHint: Think a cheerful chef tackling a huge feast.
pivHint: ZEST is the bright outer peel of a lemon or orange, grated into recipes. It is also lively energy, as in singing 'with ______.'
winText: Full of life. ZEST was the pivot - lemon peel to lively GUSTO.
lossText: GUSTO - hearty enthusiasm and energy. ZEST was the pivot: ZEST is the outer peel of a citrus fruit, but it is also a word for lively enthusiasm, as in doing something with GUSTO.
